eyebrow: The NSG rule, still pointed at the old office
code:
az network nsg rule list \
  --nsg-name app-nsg -o table

Name       Access  SourceAddressPrefix  Port
Allow-SSH  Allow   203.0.113.0/24        22
caption: The office moved to 198.51.100.0/24 — the rule never followed.

code:
az network nsg rule update \
  --nsg-name app-nsg --name Allow-SSH \
  --source-address-prefixes 198.51.100.0/24
caption: One stale IP range in a security rule — not the VM, not the route table.
